headline: Nasdaq slides toward correction as AI-linked stocks tumble
summary: The Nasdaq index fell nearly 5% as investors retreated from semiconductor and data center stocks following the US midterm elections. Analysts suggest the sell-off reflects concerns over potential new technology regulations.
why: The Nasdaq is heavily weighted toward technology and AI companies, making it sensitive to shifts in sentiment regarding sector regulation and growth expectations.

impacts.name: Technology
impacts.why: Investors are rotating out of AI-linked tech stocks.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Investors are reacting to the prospect of stricter technology regulation following the Democratic victory in the US midterm elections.
